questions.text: Is your AIMS scope defined — AI use cases, systems, models, jurisdictions and clear in/out boundaries?
Are AI governance roles defined — owners, committees and RACI covering key decisions and escalation?
Is an AI use-case inventory maintained — purpose, risks, data types, owners and risk classification?
Is an AI Impact and Risk Assessment (AIRA) methodology defined and applied before deployment and changes?
Is human oversight defined — review thresholds, escalation paths and the ability to override or disable AI?
Is AI evaluated before release and after changes — fairness, robustness, red-teaming and go/no-go records?
Is runtime monitoring in place — quality, drift, misuse and policy violations with logs and alerts?
Are AI incidents formally managed — bias harms, hallucinations and misuse handled with post-incident reviews?
Are third-party AI providers assessed — model cards, data handling, SLAs and contractual controls?
Are management reviews held covering AIMS performance, AI risks, incidents and improvements?
